# Documentation Requirements Checklist: Install and Run Documentation

**Purpose**: Review whether install/run requirements are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and safe before implementation
**Created**: 2026-10-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact for a peer reviewer during PR review. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the required source-install steps complete from repository acquisition through executable build, including prerequisites and directory transitions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are both generic local execution and App-authenticated GitHub orchestration requirements documented with an appropriate detailed-guide owner? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements present for each likely human, agent, and operator documentation surface identified in scope? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-004–FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is “prominently discoverable” bounded by the one-navigation-step outcome so reviewers can assess it objectively? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK005 Does each command-sequence requirement unambiguously identify prerequisites, starting directory, workflow-path expectation, execution mode, and intended outcome? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the generic launcher and safe GitHub launcher named as distinct modes without language that could imply they are interchangeable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §SC-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Are canonical ownership requirements consistent between the functional requirements, assumptions, plan, and documentation-surface contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004–FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Are repeated command requirements constrained to agree on spelling, ordering, working directory, and workflow-path usage across all in-scope surfaces? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK009 Are source-checkout startup and dedicated issue-workspace boundaries stated consistently with the credential and workspace safety requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK010 Can command copyability be assessed without an undocumented directory transition or unstated prerequisite? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK011 Are zero-conflict and zero-broken-link outcomes defined across a concrete, bounded set of documentation surfaces? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK012 Can a reviewer classify every launch example by execution mode using only the documented requirements? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are primary human quick-start and agent-operable setup requirements each independently reviewable? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK014 Are alternate source and prebuilt-binary paths distinguished without expanding the requested source quick start into a second canonical procedure? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK015 Are exception requirements defined for a missing repository-owned workflow and for commands copied from the wrong starting directory? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the absence of rollback/recovery requirements justified by the documentation-only, non-state-mutating scope? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]

## Safety and Dependencies

- [ ] CHK017 Are credential-handling exclusions explicit enough to prevent instructions that copy secrets into tracked files, prompts, workspaces, issues, logs, commits, or pull requests? [Safety, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements explicit that normal orchestration starts from the Symphony Plus source checkout while issue work remains in dedicated issue workspaces? [Safety, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the supported toolchain, checked-in scripts, generated launcher, and workflow-file dependencies identified without assuming they already exist on a clean host? [Dependencies, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the no-runtime-change boundary sufficiently explicit to exclude changes to behavior, configuration semantics, release artifacts, and `SPEC.md`? [Scope, Spec §FR-010]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline and link to relevant requirements or documentation.
